introduction.situation: Religion and theology study how humans relate to the ultimate through belief, texts, acts and organised communities.
introduction.complication: The existing groups mix library classes with research-field labels, and the same traditions appear several times.
introduction.question: How is everything in religion and theology divided?
introduction.answer: Religion and theology are divided by what the study is about, namely the ultimate and the human condition, authoritative text, practice, and community and institution, moving from the referent to its carriers.

governing_thought: Religion and theology are divided by what the study is about, namely the ultimate and the human condition, authoritative text, practice, and community and institution, moving from the referent to its carriers.

key_line.mece_dimension: what the study of religion is about
key_line.rank_note: The pillars run from the referent of religion to the texts, acts and communities that carry it.

points.statement: The ultimate and the human condition is the object of study when the subject is what is believed about the divine, the sacred and human nature.
points.name: The ultimate and the human condition is the object of study when the subject is what is believed about the divine, the sacred and human nature.

support.rank_note: From doctrine and philosophical reflection to the comparative study of religions.

points.title: The ultimate and the human condition

points.statement: Authoritative text is the object of study when the subject is the scriptures and the binding legal corpora of religious traditions.
points.name: Authoritative text is the object of study when the subject is the scriptures and the binding legal corpora of religious traditions.

support.rank_note: From scripture and general religious law to the particular legal traditions.

points.statement: Scripture and general religious law are the foundational texts and the comparative frame for all religious legal reasoning.
points.name: Scripture and general religious law are the foundational texts and the comparative frame for all religious legal reasoning.

support.rank_note: From scripture to law in general.

points.statement: Religious law in general. Comparative religious law. Jurisprudence

points.statement: Particular legal traditions are the binding legal corpora developed within the Jewish, Islamic and Catholic traditions.
points.name: Particular legal traditions are the binding legal corpora developed within the Jewish, Islamic and Catholic traditions.

support.rank_note: From Jewish and Islamic law to the Catholic canon law.

points.statement: Law of the Roman Catholic Church. The Holy See
points.name: Law of the Roman Catholic Church. The Holy See

points.statement: Practice is the object of study when the subject is how religion is lived out in ministry, conduct, society and culture.
points.name: Practice is the object of study when the subject is how religion is lived out in ministry, conduct, society and culture.

support.rank_note: From the practice of ministry to religion's wider social and cultural expression.

points.title: Practice

points.statement: Community and institution is the object of study when the subject is the religious traditions as organised bodies of adherents.
points.name: Community and institution is the object of study when the subject is the religious traditions as organised bodies of adherents.

support.rank_note: From Christian communities to Abrahamic neighbours and then to Eastern and other traditions.

points.statement: Christian communities are the churches and denominations that carry the Christian tradition.
points.name: Christian communities are the churches and denominations that carry the Christian tradition.
